verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS feedback and support platform, so choosing a data-residency region is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency selection or data location. Content in 40+ languages and custom domains are about localization and branding, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
